steps: The Chill of the Blade, the Warmth of Your Grip (Part III)
It seems that Chitose's lifesaver is in danger. She decides to step in and help. This will be the beginning of a strange and unforgettable relationship...
(It's so late... What business could they have here?)
(They were arguing with someone... Then that person fled.)
(... The side who looked stronger ran. Does that mean ... my lifesaver's squad is even more powerful?)
That shadow is blocking our magic.
I heard Feagin. She contacted the Imperial Guard.
We're gonna be surrounded any minute. No time to hunt them down.
Let's get Loxy out of here first!
(They're leaving ... but it looks like they're about to have company.)
04:15, Pluvia Month 2nd, Gold District in Emor, Waterway Corridor
Hear about that? Creta's old miser put a bounty on five Trekkers—a million Dorra a head.
Feagin coughing up that much? Those five must've really messed with Creta Trading. Almost makes you not wanna go after 'em.
Look at you, getting all sympathetic!==W== Bag this bounty, and we can kick back for months.
Yeah, you're right.==W== Roof's leaking, and gotta pay back that weapon loan...==W== If we run into those Trekkers, guess it's just their bad luck.
They gotta be using the Waterway to get around. We'll set up an ambush right here.
Apologies.==W== I'm afraid I can't let you do that.
Hey, you just split my damn sword!
Dammit, see? This is why I didn't wanna mess with them...
Hey, get up! This is no time to be resti—
(My lifesaver is here... Let me hide somewhere.)
(Hmm... Is this enough to repay the debt?)
Oh! You must mean those Trekkers! They just got back to Emor recently. Right now, they're helping the Ashwind Clan fight back against Creta Trading.
They've got a real fight on their hands...==W== I heard some knights took commissions from Creta Trading. Looks like the company's ready to play dirty.
(It sounds like ... more enemies await them.)
(... Should I continue to follow them?)
The area ahead is blocked. Do not go any further.
It's very dangerous. This is for your own safety.
(This aura... The work of a seasoned warrior.)
(... If I just identify myself as a "Trekker" in the city, I should avoid suspicion.)
Thank you for the warning, but there is no need for concern. I am merely a Trekker passing through.
I see. After the bounty, are you?
I'm the Imperial Knight assigned to this incident. The targets are on the run. If you intend to join the hunt...
Speak of the devil. There they are now. Those Trekkers are a tenacious bunch.
(Those people on the skateboards... Wait, isn't that my lifesaver and ==SEX3== squad?!)
(Then this person before me ... must be their pursuer.)
"Bother," you say...? I see...You're not here to hunt the bounty. You are the bounty.
If you don't know them, what's with the overflowing hostility?
Forgive me. I bear you no ill will...
Hmph. You've got some moves.==W== But don't you dare underestimate an Imperial Knight!
(She saw right through me... She's the real deal.)
And that is exactly why I cannot let you pass!
Not backing down? Fine.==W== The gloves are coming off!
(... Lightning!? This is going to be tough to counter.)
(... But I can't let that stop me...)
Hah, that's some unique magic you have. It's quite sharp.
(Did my uncontrollable aura deter her?...==W== Well, at least I stop her, then—)
Your magic is very powerful, but—
Young Trekker, in a fight, relying on brute force alone is useless.
No more fooling around—the big catch’s here!
No! She's aiming at ...==W== my lifesaver—!
I'm afraid I can't let you do that!
(If my blade can't keep up with her spear, I shal use my body to stop—)
(Huh? I can... control my aura again.)
The books I'd read mentioned that once I found a worthy wielder, everything would fall into place.
(Could it be that ... ==SEX== is not only my lifesaver, but also...)
My apologies for the delay, my ==SEX11==.
Hmm... Your magic has suddenly become so smooth... Were you holding back just now?
But swords and guns have no mercy. If you don't want to lose your life, then stop rambling about lifesaving and all!
My apologies, but for me, ==SEX== is not merely a lifesaver;==W== ==SEX=='s also my wielder...
To put it in common words, ==SEX=='s my ==SEX11==.
So you have your reasons. But I have my orders...
All units! While she's distracted, capture the target!
(I'm still holding up, but barely... There are too many of them. If this keeps up...)
==PLAYER_NAME==, and that righteous Trekker who helped us. All of you, run! I'll hold them off here!
Are you okay? You're not hurt?
Leave this to Ashwind. We'll retreat together.
Un-Understood. Oh, my ==SEX11==, please don't stand so close to me...
Argh—! My pauldron's cracked! What did you do?!
Agh—! Ow! My hand—how did it get cut?!
No, my ==SEX11==! If you touch me... You'll get hurt—
(==SEX1=='s holding my hand ... but ==SEX3== hand is unharmed...)
In the underground clinic in Ash District, Chitose lays out her bedroll and lies down beside the hospital bed.
She isn't actually asleep, but merely fulfilling the duty of a blade—
As your blade, my ==SEX11==, I must naturally remain close at hand.
For Chitose, the person beside her had already become her ==SEX11==.
(The apple beside me was somehow sliced in half ... without me noticing.)
(But you ... you can hold my hand without getting hurt... It's incredible.)
I never knew ... that holding a hand could feel so warm and comforting.
Chitose, carve your own path with your own two hands... That is your next trial.
Will you hold me in your hand?
(I know... There's no answer for now.)
(But you are the only one, the wielder, who can touch me without getting hurt.)
Please allow me to take the liberty of addressing you in this way.
I only hope that when you wake up ... you'll give me your answer.
